cadence_description: 5m -> 30m -> 3h -> 6h (+6h) -> 6h (+6h) -> 6h (+6h final). App booking help only: never asks timing/teacher/package/fees in chat, never books or confirms a trial in chat, no QR, no paid pitch.

5m.message: Hi! 😊 Kya aap Sensationz App mein apni free trial class book kar paaye? Koi dikkat aaye toh bataiye, main help karta hoon! 🙏

Namaste! ✨ Trial book karna bahut aasan hai:
1. Sensationz App download karein
2. Google se login karein
3. Profile → Trial Links
4. Apni pasand ki timing select karke 'Confirm Trial Enrollment' par tap karein 🌸
Hello! 🎥 Agar app mein trial book karne mein confusion ho, toh 'GUIDE' likh dijiye — main 1 minute ka video guide bhej dunga. 😊
Hi! 📱 App download karne mein koi dikkat to nahi aayi? Android aur iPhone dono par Sensationz App available hai. 'LINK' likhiye, main link bhej deta hoon! ✨
Namaste! 🌟 Yaad rahe, trial classes bilkul free hain — koi payment nahi lagta. Bas app mein Profile → Trial Links se book kar lijiye! 🙏

30m.message: Namaste! 😊 App mein login karne ke baad niche 'Profile' par jaiye, wahan 'Trial Links' milega. Wahin se aap apni trial class book kar sakte hain! ✨
Hello! 🌸 Trial ki timing aap khud app mein choose kar sakte hain — jo bhi aapke routine mein fit ho. Booking ke baad class app mein dikh jaayegi! 🙏
Hi! 📲 Login mein dikkat aa rahi ho toh 'Continue with Google' option use kijiye — sabse aasan hai. Phir bhi problem ho toh bataiye! 😊
Namaste! ✨ Trial classes bhi poori tarah live aur interactive hoti hain — certified teacher aapko real-time guide karte hain. App mein book karke khud experience kijiye! 🌟
Hello! 😊 Class ke format, teacher ya app ke baare mein koi sawaal ho toh yahan pooch lijiye. Booking app mein hi hoti hai, par help main yahan kar sakta hoon! 🙏

3h.message: Namaste! 🌸 Bas yaad dila raha tha — aapki free trial classes app mein aapka intezaar kar rahi hain. Profile → Trial Links se book kar lijiye! 😊
Hello! 📱💻 Trial class aap mobile, tablet ya laptop kisi par bhi join kar sakte hain. Bas stable internet aur thodi khuli jagah chahiye! ✨
Hi! 🌟 Trial class ke liye comfortable kapde, paani ki bottle aur thodi khuli jagah ready rakhiye. Baaki sab teacher class mein sikha denge! 🙏
Namaste! 🎥 Agar booking ke steps samajh nahi aa rahe, toh 'GUIDE' likhiye — main video guide bhej deta hoon jisme sab step-by-step dikhaya gaya hai. 😊
Hello! ✨ Pehle se koi experience zaroori nahi hai — trial class beginners ke liye bilkul comfortable hoti hai. App mein book karke try kijiye! 🌸

6h_step3.message: Namaste! 🙏 Kya aapne trial book kar liya? Agar app mein koi error ya problem aa rahi hai toh screenshot ke bajaye yahan likh ke bataiye, hum help karenge. 😊
Hello! ✨ Agar 'Trial Links' nahi dikh raha, toh app ko update karke dobara login kijiye. Phir bhi na dikhe toh bataiye! 🌸
Hi! 😊 Trial book karne ke baad class time se 5 minute pehle app khol lijiye, taaki aap aaram se join kar sakein. 🌟
Namaste! 🌸 Trial ka maksad yahi hai ki aap pehle khud class ka experience lein, phir decide karein. Koi pressure nahi hai! App mein book kar lijiye. 🙏
Hello! 📲 App, login ya booking — kisi bhi cheez mein help chahiye ho toh bas reply kar dijiye. Main yahin hoon! ✨

6h_step4.message: Namaste! 😊 Kya aap abhi bhi trial class lena chahte hain? Jab bhi time mile, app mein Profile → Trial Links se book kar sakte hain. 🌸
Hello! ✨ Agar aapne trial class le li hai, toh kaisi lagi? Aapka feedback jaanna hamare liye bahut keemti hai! 🙏
Hi! 🌟 Agar kisi wajah se trial class miss ho gayi, toh koi baat nahi — app mein dobara Trial Links se doosri timing book kar sakte hain. 😊
Namaste! 📱 Agar app download ya login abhi tak nahi hua, toh 'LINK' ya 'GUIDE' likhiye — main turant bhej dunga. 🌸
Hello! 😊 Teacher, class format ya syllabus ke baare mein koi sawaal ho toh yahan pooch lijiye. Main jawab dene ke liye yahin hoon! ✨

6h_step5_trials.message: Namaste! 🙏 Aapki free trial classes abhi bhi available hain. Jab bhi aap ready hon, app mein Profile → Trial Links se book kar lijiye. Hum aapka intezaar karenge! 😊
Hello! 🌸 Agar trial class attend ki hai, toh batayein aapko kaisi lagi? Agar abhi tak nahi ki, toh koi jaldi nahi — app mein kabhi bhi book kar sakte hain! ✨
Hi! 😊 Jab bhi aapko time mile, app mein trial book kar lijiye. Koi bhi sawaal ho toh bas yahan likh dijiye! 🙏
Namaste! 🌟 App mein trial booking ya class join karne mein koi bhi technical dikkat ho, toh bataiye — hum step-by-step help karenge. 😊
Hello! ✨ Aapki learning journey ke liye hamari shubhkamnayein! Trial ke baare mein koi bhi sawaal ho, main hamesha yahin hoon. 🌸
